scope: Reservation conservatively covers actual yielded satisfiability assignments plus returned illustration-work units for this measured population; analytical union argument covers the supported typed table representation. Not wall-clock measurement or new clinical guarantee.
formula: P(all domain/constraint/row/prohibition formulas, capped by solver_bound) * min(2+prohibitions+row_pairs+actions, solver_calls, MAX_WORK//(solver_bound*3)) * (2*assertion_count+4) + MAX_CASE_WORK
counter_instrument: Count each assignment yielded by itertools.product inside entail._satisfiable; instrument satisfiability call count independently. Table case enumeration uses its own already-bound product reference; add returned witness_summary.work separately.
